item.title: 3.6 Transparency Obligations
item.description:
Implementation phase

This clause is implemented in Phase 2: AI Extension Processes. View the full implementation roadmap

1. Clause Overview

If license obligations (3.5) ask “do we have the right to use this material,” transparency obligations ask “what must we disclose about this material.” The two obligations come from different sources. License obligations are imposed by copyright holders through contract, and transparency obligations are imposed by regulations through law.

3.6 requires a procedure for reviewing whether there are transparency obligations imposed by regulations. The review covers training, testing, and verification datasets and takes into account the intended use of the model. If the use case for the training data creates a transparency issue (e.g., disclosure obligations to downstream recipients), appropriate risk mitigation measures must be taken. As the EU AI Act begins to fully apply its transparency obligations from August 2026, this clause is becoming more important in practice.

item.title: AI Extension Processes
item.description: This is Phase 2 of the implementation roadmap. It is the area where the AI SBOM guide extends ISO/IEC 5230 the most, and it covers license obligations (3.5), transparency obligations (3.6), and AI SBOM creation and management (3.9).
